project_title: Marketplace & UMKM Seller KPI Analytics & Reporting SaaS (IdSeller Pulse)

theme_strategy.rationale: High-density daily ecommerce operations benefit from rich contrast, low eye fatigue during long sessions, and distinct status color highlights (Green/Amber/Red for KPI achievement).

typography.font_family_heading: Cabinet Grotesk, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif

rules.Overline_Label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 dark:text-emerald-400
rules.Metric_Value: font-mono text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

colors.archetype: Tactical Emerald & Slate (ARCHETYPE 2: The Performance Pro / Command Center)

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: MODE B: High Density Dashboard Grid (Density, Scannability & Instant Action)
layout_and_spacing.padding_rules: Cards & containers MUST have p-5 or p-6 to avoid content crowding. Use gap-4 to gap-6 for dashboard widgets.
layout_and_spacing.alignment_rules: Data metrics right-aligned or crisp left-aligned with monospace numbers. Navigation sticky top z-50 with backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800).
layout_and_spacing.mobile_rules: Grid items stack on mobile (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). Dynamic tables wrap with horizontal scroll and clean indicators.

steps: Step 1: Profil Perusahaan (Nama Toko/UMKM, Category, Period)
Step 2: Target Penjualan Bulanan (Total Sales target, multi-channel share)
Step 3: Budget Ads (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Shopee Ads, Tokopedia Ads)
Step 4: Budget Branding (Awareness, Consideration, Activation, Clipper)
Step 5: Budget Campaign (Promo Diskon, Voucher, Tanggal Kembar)
Step 6: Budget KOL & Target (Total budget, target jumlah KOL micro/macro)
Step 7: Target Live Streaming (Jumlah tim, target jam live, target omzet live)

features: Dynamic 1-to-many Multi-Akun per platform (e.g., Toko Tiktok Official, Toko Tiktok Affiliate 1, Shopee Official, WA Sales Admin 1)
Ads Tracker (Budget Keluar, Revenue Omzet, CPA, ROI calculation auto)
Branding Tracker (Awareness, Consideration, Offline Event, Buzzer/Clipper)
Live Streaming Log Team Granular (Nama Streamer, Jam Mulai, Jam Selesai, Omzet Harian)
KOL Activation Tracker (KOL Name, Rate card, Target vs Realisasi Reach/Sales)

widgets: Summary Cards: Target Bulanan vs Prorate Harian, Time Elapsed vs KPI Achieved %
Prorate Target Gauge & Progress Indicator (Positive/Negative % with green/red badges)
Sales Trend Chart (Recharts ResponsiveContainer: Multi-channel breakdown)
Ads ROI & CPA Efficiency Chart (Recharts Bar/Line composite)
Live Streaming Performance Grid (Granular Streamer Log + Daily Revenue)

ai_recommendation_panel.trigger: Button 'Analisa AI KPI Red Alert' with glowing amber/red state when sub-target is underperforming
features: Root cause breakdown for Red KPIs (e.g. CPA TikTok Ads spikes > 35%, Live streaming duration down 2.5 hrs)
Actionable Step-by-Step Fixes for Marketplace Sellers (e.g. Shift 20% budget from Meta to Shopee Search Ads, change live streamer peak hour slot)
AI Confidence score & expected revenue recovery calculation

image_urls.description: Indonesian business team collaborating on marketplace seller strategy
E-commerce operation meeting & team performance tracking
Seller checking daily store revenue and ads performance

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive inputs, buttons, steps, modals, charts, and metric displays MUST include kebab-case `data-testid` attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-ready, highly interactive dashboard application in standard Javascript/React (.js files) with Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and Recharts.
Implement mock state management so user inputs in Onboarding Wizard (7 steps) and Daily Data Input forms dynamically update the Dashboard Metrics, Charts, and Red KPI Status instantly.

Provide initial pre-populated realistic Indonesian UMKM seller dataset (e.g. Toko Fashion Batik Nusantara / Skincare Glow Seller with TikTok, Shopee, Tokopedia, Meta Ads, Live Streaming team log) so the dashboard looks rich and full immediately upon load.
Implement the 'Analisa AI' drawer/modal with realistic AI prompt simulation that reads current red KPIs and generates structured, highly contextual Indonesian marketplace seller advice.
Ensure dark mode aesthetic with crisp slate/dark indigo backgrounds, glowing emerald status indicators, clear border framing, and responsive layout for mobile and desktop.
